newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grants 480,000 t free-mkt wheat, 294,000 barley.
newsitem.headline: EU grants 480,000 t free-mkt wheat, 294,000 barley.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted licences to export 480,000 tonnes of free-market soft wheat to non-EU countries at a maximum rebate of 9.30 Ecus per tonne, EU member country officials said.
The EU's grain panel meeting in Brussels also awarded licences for the export of 294,000 tonnes of free-market barley at a maximum rebate of 29.98 Ecus per tonne, they said.
The EU granted licences for the export of 3,000 tonnes of free-market oats to Switzerland at a maximum rebate of 26.94 Ecus per tonne.
It also awarded licences for the export of 6,000 tonnes of free-market rye at a maximum rebate of 34.95 Ecus per tonne.
But it rejected bids to export free-market Greek maize, and to export German intervention rye to non-EU countries, member-country officials said.
The EU also raised its export allocation for German intervention rye by 200,000 tonnes, a European Commission official said.
